text: In the standard basis $\{e,f,h\}$ of $\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb{C})$, which bracket relation is correct?
explanation: The defining relations are $[h,e]=2e$, $[h,f]=-2f$, and $[e,f]=h$. The coefficient on $[h,e]$ is $2$ (the value of the root on $h$), not $1$; $[e,f]=h$ has no factor of $2$; and $[h,f]=-2f$ carries a minus sign.
